title: 5.1 Introduction to the Internet
description: The internet concepts and details. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term-description pair is correctly matched?
options: IP: addresses packets and selects routes
questions.correctAnswer: IP: addresses packets and selects routes

questions.question: A company needs to host a website and register a domain. Which organization provides both?
Why can packets of one message take different routes?
options: TCP numbers every byte of data
The browser renders the pages in order

questions.question: Which mechanism lets TCP detect a lost segment?
options: An acknowledgment that fails to arrive in time
A sequence number that falls outside the range
A FIN message sent by the receiver
A DNS lookup that returns no address
questions.correctAnswer: An acknowledgment that fails to arrive in time

questions.question: What does the SYN-ACK message indicate?
options: Computer B is ready to establish the connection
Computer A has finished sending all of its data
The receiver has lost a data segment
questions.correctAnswer: Computer B is ready to establish the connection

questions.question: Which messages politely end a TCP connection?
Which statement about TCP and IP is accurate?
options: TCP sits on top of IP
IP sits on top of TCP
questions.correctAnswer: TCP sits on top of IP

questions.question: Why are some IPv4 addresses unavailable for public devices?
options: Some ranges are reserved for special purposes
They are all assigned to private companies worldwide
The protocol limits them to one country
They expire after a fixed time period
questions.correctAnswer: Some ranges are reserved for special purposes

questions.question: Which fields appear in an IP packet header?
What does a router do with each packet?
options: It reads the destination address and picks a hop
It encrypts the packet contents before sending
It renders the requested web page for the user
It stores each packet for later retrieval by the server
questions.correctAnswer: It reads the destination address and picks a hop

questions.question: What does best-effort delivery mean?
options: Packets may be lost or arrive out of order
Every packet is guaranteed to arrive on time
Packets are always delivered in order
questions.correctAnswer: Packets may be lost or arrive out of order

questions.question: Which set contains only security measures?
options: DNS, HTTP, SMTP and FTP protocols

questions.question: Which activity is an example of cloud computing?
options: Connecting two computers with a cable

questions.question: What does a switch forward packets toward?
What is the role of servers in data exchange?
options: They store, send and receive data
They only display pages to end users
questions.correctAnswer: They store, send and receive data

questions.question: Which example matches healthcare on the Internet?
Which example matches entertainment on the Internet?
Which example matches education on the Internet?
Which statement about packets is accurate?
options: Different packets may follow different paths
All packets follow one fixed path
Packets never cross any national borders at all
Packets are always sent in order
questions.correctAnswer: Different packets may follow different paths

questions.question: Which layer of the Internet carries data as packets?
